hierarchy_goals: Close with an executable path, limitations, and visible source notes.
negative_space_target: sufficient for native title, semantic objects, and visible source notes
prompt_text: Create a landscape 16:9 full-slide visual reconstruction target for role implementation_roadmap. This is visual truth only, never the final slide surface. Composition requirements: directional roadmap, visibly ordered phases and actions, native steps and connectors, explicit source-note region, clear professional closing state. Treat the linked Semantic Sidecar as the sole authority for exact wording, numbers, units, data, citations, accessibility, and native/raster policy. Reserve clean native reconstruction regions for title, subtitle, labels, body, structured data, citations, footer, and page number. Prefer no rendered text beyond large generic semantic labels. No paragraphs, full citations, tiny source notes, dense table text, tiny chart labels, pseudo-language, invented numbers, quotations, logos, watermarks, screenshots, dashboard walls, or full-slide raster background. Do not render digits, numerals, numbered labels, percentages, dates, quantities, or any other numeric characters; use unlabeled geometry or alphabetic placeholders only.
